hammerFalls.copy: The timer ends and the highest bid wins.

settleCta.copy: The seller gets paid and you get the card, in one step. We never hold your money or your cards.

product.heading: Hammerprice is live
product.copy: Hammerprice is live and currently in beta with the Colosseum hackathon. We plan to make it reachable on Solana mainnet shortly after the hackathon. The waiting list tells you when that happens.

journeys.heading: What you can do on Hammerprice
journeys.intro: From your first bid to your own sale, and more besides. Every button and link leads to the real page. The small pictures are examples, not live data.

bid.title: Bid in live rooms
bid.lead: A live room sells its lots one after another on the server clock. The demo rooms are labelled as tutorials.
steps: Connect your wallet and get a bidder number with one signature.
Bid with a signed message. Your USDC balance is checked, nothing is locked.
A bid in the last seconds adds time, so nobody gets sniped.
Win and pay with one signature: USDC goes to the seller and the card comes to you. We hold nothing in between.

sell.title: Create a room and sell your card
sell.lead: Sell a graded card from your own wallet. You set the terms and Hammerprice runs the auction.
steps: Connect your wallet and pick the card from it. Each card shows whether it can be sold.
Let the AI draft the listing text if you like. You review and edit it before it is used.
Choose the lot length and an optional minimum price, then go live. You can pause and resume the room.
You are paid in USDC at the hammer. Hammerprice keeps 2.5 percent of the hammer price from the seller, and that is the only fee we charge.

packs.title: Offer or open a pack
packs.lead: A pack is a sealed draw from a public pool of real cards. A seller builds it from cards in their own wallet, the buyer pays the seller directly, and a draw that anyone can recheck picks the card.
steps: A seller with a signed-in wallet picks real cards from that wallet. Availability can be limited to approved sellers.
The seller sorts the cards into 1 to 8 tiers, sets the odds per tier in percent (they must add up to 100) and the price in USDC, then publishes.
The odds, the whole card pool and a commitment hash are public before the first sale. After publishing, none of it can be changed.
A buyer (18 or older) pays the seller directly with one signature. Only when that payment is final does the verifiable random draw (ECVRF) pick the card.
The seller delivers the drawn card from their own wallet to the buyer within the deadline. Every draw has a public proof page and every seller a public delivery record.

mock.name: Starter pack
mock.pool: The whole pool, public before the first sale

flow.heading: Peer to peer: who does what
flow.f1s: Owns the cards and builds the pack.
flow.f2s: Straight to the seller wallet, with one signature.
flow.f3s: Only after the payment is final.
flow.f4s: The drawn card goes from the seller wallet to the buyer wallet.
flow.platform: Hammerprice sits beside the flow: it pays the network fee, takes its fee in the same payment and shows the proof page. It never receives the price and never holds a card.

odds.title: How the odds work
odds.line: Odds, pool and draw are public and can be recomputed.

build.title: Build your own pack
build.line: Pick cards, set tiers and a price, then publish.

delivery.title: No pool at Hammerprice
delivery.line: You pay the seller directly; Hammerprice holds no money.

chat.title: Chat in the room
chat.lead: Every room has a pre-moderated chat, so the talk stays about the cards.
steps: Signed-in bidders can write. Everyone else can read the approved messages.
Your message waits for approval. Until then only you see it.
The room owner gets a popup with a preview and approves or rejects it.
The public chat shows a bidder number or a display name, never a wallet address.

telegram.title: Buy and bid from Telegram
telegram.lead: Connect the bot @hammerpricebot and follow a room from your phone. Alerts are opt-in.
steps: Connect Telegram in your profile with one tap on Start.
Get an alert when you are outbid and when you win.
Send /watch 3, /watch 5, /watch 10 or /watch all to hear when the next lots of a live room open.
Tap the Bid button under an alert: the room opens with the amount filled in and you confirm in your wallet. The bot never bids for you.

mock.head: Lot 3 is open
mock.left: 90 seconds left. Nothing is bid for you.

agent.title: Ask the AI agent
agent.lead: Talk to the agent in German or English. It only makes proposals, you decide.
steps: Search open and upcoming lots in your own words.
Have it prepare a bid proposal, or draft a listing for a card you want to sell.
A signed-in wallet is required. You confirm every step yourself, and the agent never bids or pays.

mock.ask: Find a PSA 10 Charizard under 500 USDC
mock.answer: 2 lots found. Shall I prepare a bid proposal?

profile.title: Your profile and wallet
profile.lead: One page for everything that is yours.
steps: Choose a username and a picture.
See your USDC and SOL balance and the cards in your wallet.
Follow your bids, wins and payments, and your sales with their prices.
Choose which Telegram alerts you get.

timed.title: Timed auctions
timed.line: One card, open for hours or days. It closes by itself, with a soft close against last-second sniping.

random.title: Verifiable random lot order
random.line: The order of the lots is drawn with a public ECVRF proof that anyone can recompute.

packs.title: Packs
packs.line: A sealed draw from a public pool of cards, with the odds, the pool and a proof anyone can recheck.

video.title: Live video
video.line: A seller can add a live camera to a show. You load the picture with one click.

draft.title: AI listing draft and room assistant
draft.line: Sellers get a draft title and text in German and English to review, and a room assistant answers from our FAQ.

verify.title: Public audit and verify pages
verify.line: Every paid lot has a page that rechecks the signed bids and reads the payment from the Solana network.

languages.title: German and English
languages.line: The whole site is available in both languages.

wallets.title: Wallet support
wallets.line: Phantom, Solflare and Backpack. Signing in is a free signature, not a transaction.

wallet.heading: Need a wallet?
wallet.lede: To bid you need a Solana wallet in your browser. It is free and takes two minutes.
